Future<void> run(groups, other, read, output) async {
  for (final batch in groups) {
    final futures = <Future<Row>>[];
    for (final item in batch) futures.add(read(item));
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    output.addAll(await Future.wait(futures));
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    final futures = <Future<Row>>[];
    for (final item in batch) {
      futures.add(read(item));
    }
    report(futures.length);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final rows = await Future.wait<Row>(futures);
    output.addAll(rows);
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    final futures = <Future<Row>>[];
    for (final item in other) {
      futures.add(read(item));
    }
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(futures);
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    final futures = <Future<Row>>[];
    for (final item in batch) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      futures.add(await read(item));
    }
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(futures);
  }
}
